screening_decisions.reason: Randomized double-blind trial comparing DDAVP to placebo in elective aortic surgery. Meets criteria: RCT, DDAVP vs placebo, surgical patients.
Double-blind randomized prospective study comparing DDAVP to placebo in hip arthroplasty. Meets criteria.
Meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials, not a primary RCT. Study design does not meet inclusion criteria.
Randomized study comparing DDAVP to aprotinin (active comparator) and placebo in cardiopulmonary bypass. Meets criteria.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP in CABG patients on aspirin. Meets criteria.
Randomized controlled trial but comparator is no DDAVP (not placebo, not an active comparator as specified). Does not meet selection criteria for comparator.
Prospective, double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT of DDAVP in cardiac surgery patients identified by point-of-care test. Meets criteria.
Study does not clearly report being randomized; design unclear. Likely not an RCT. Does not meet inclusion criteria.
Summary of NICE guidance on blood transfusion; not a randomized controlled trial.
Double-blind RCT comparing DDAVP to placebo in total hip replacement patients receiving dextran. Meets criteria.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trial of DDAVP in patients with excessive bleeding after cardiopulmonary bypass. Meets criteria.
RCT comparing DDAVP to saline placebo in valvular heart surgery. Meets criteria.

RCT comparing intranasal DDAVP to blood transfusion (FFP/platelets). Blood transfusion is not a placebo nor an active pharmacological comparator as defined (e.g., tranexamic acid, aprotinin). Does not meet comparator requirements.
Double-blind prospective RCT of DDAVP vs placebo in total joint arthroplasty. Meets criteria.
Study does not explicitly state randomization; likely a non-randomized controlled study. Does not meet RCT inclusion criterion.
Randomized clinical trial comparing DDAVP to saline placebo in functional endoscopic sinus surgery. Meets criteria.
Randomized, double-blind, controlled trial of DDAVP vs placebo in spinal fusion surgery. Meets criteria.
Double-blind randomized trial of DDAVP vs saline placebo in cardiac surgery patients pretreated with aspirin. Meets criteria.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT comparing aprotinin, DDAVP, and placebo in CPB patients. DDAVP compared to active comparator and placebo; meets criteria.
Double-blind RCT of DDAVP vs placebo in CABG patients; although primary outcome is hemodynamics, it is an RCT in surgical patients evaluating DDAVP. Meets design criteria.
Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP in patients on CPB. Meets criteria.
Double-blind study comparing DDAVP and placebo in spinal fusion for neuromuscular scoliosis; randomized controlled trial; meets criteria.
Randomized, double-blind trial of DDAVP vs placebo in routine CABG. Meets criteria.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of transfusion strategies; not an RCT of DDAVP.
Methodological paper on meta-analysis of binary endpoints; not a clinical trial of DDAVP.
RCT (prospective, blinded, randomized) comparing DDAVP to placebo in cardiac surgery, measuring blood loss and transfusion. Meets criteria.
Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP in cardiac surgery, reporting blood loss and transfusion outcomes. Meets criteria.
Double-blind, randomized study of DDAVP vs placebo in cardiac surgery, evaluating bleeding and replacement volume. Meets criteria.
Not an RCT; appears to be a letter to the editor commenting on lumbar puncture and morphine use, not a study on DDAVP efficacy for blood loss.
RCT (randomized, blinded comparison) of DDAVP vs placebo in pediatric cardiac surgery, assessing blood loss and replacement. Meets criteria.
RCT (randomized double-blind placebo-controlled) of DDAVP in cardiac surgery, evaluating blood loss and platelet aggregation. Meets criteria.
Not about DDAVP; retrospective cohort study on mortality in patients declining transfusion, not an RCT of desmopressin.
RCT of desmopressin for thromboprophylaxis in cardiac catheterization; outcome is thrombosis, not perioperative blood loss or transfusion. Not relevant to review question.
Double-blind RCT of DDAVP vs placebo in percutaneous kidney biopsy (invasive procedure), evaluating bleeding complications. Meets criteria for invasive procedure.
Guideline on diagnosis and management of von Willebrand disease; not an RCT, and focuses on inherited bleeding disorder. Excluded population.
Double-blind, randomized clinical trial of DDAVP vs placebo in scoliosis surgery, measuring blood loss. Meets criteria.
RCT comparing two doses of DDAVP to placebo in total hip arthroplasty, assessing blood loss and transfusion. Meets criteria.

Likely an RCT (based on title indicating it's a study to reduce transfusion requirements) in cardiac surgery patients with platelet dysfunction. Abstract truncated but appears to be a trial comparing DDAVP, possibly to placebo. Conservative include.
Narrative review article summarizing DDAVP use in hematological disorders and surgical bleeding. Not an original RCT.
Not an original study; appears to be a commentary or news item summarizing a biopsy trial, not the trial itself.
Review article on transfusion reactions; not about DDAVP, not an RCT.
Placebo-controlled, randomized clinical trial of DDAVP in burn débridement and grafting surgery, measuring blood loss. Meets criteria.
Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP in elective cardiac surgery, evaluating blood loss and transfusion. Meets criteria.
Survey of RBC utilization in England and Wales; not about DDAVP, not an RCT.
Observational study of reoperation for bleeding in CABG; not an RCT, and does not evaluate DDAVP.
Guideline on platelet transfusions; not about DDAVP, not an RCT.
Multicenter RCT of DDAVP vs placebo in cardiac surgery patients with active bleeding (pre-treated with tranexamic acid), assessing transfusion requirements. Meets criteria.
Methodological paper on funnel plots in meta-analysis; not about DDAVP, not an RCT.
Review article on cellular mechanisms of DDAVP; not an RCT.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP in spinal cord injury patients having flap reconstruction, measuring blood loss and transfusion. Meets criteria.

Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in 20 CABG patients comparing DDAVP to placebo. Assesses blood loss and transfusion, meeting population (no inherited bleeding disorders), intervention (DDAVP vs placebo), comparator, and setting (cardiac surgery).
Study is in a patient with Bernard-Soulier syndrome, an inherited bleeding disorder. The review excludes people with inherited bleeding disorders. Additionally, not a surgical population or RCT.
Not a randomised controlled trial; it is a clinical practice guideline. Also focused on hereditary bleeding disorders.
Not described as a randomized controlled trial; appears to be a non-randomized cohort study with groups based on antiplatelet use and bleeding tendency, not randomized assignment.
Not a randomised controlled trial; it is a clinical practice guideline update.
This is a meta-analysis, not a randomised controlled trial. The review includes only primary RCTs.
This is a meta-analysis, not a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet study design criterion.
Not a randomised controlled trial; it is a narrative review article discussing alternatives to platelet transfusion.
The study is described as prospective single-blind but does not mention randomization. Without explicit randomization, it does not meet the RCT criterion.
Single-arm study (all patients received desmopressin). Not a randomized controlled trial; lacks a comparator group.

Although a prospective randomized trial, it is conducted in uremic patients not undergoing surgery, and the outcome is platelet function (closure time), not perioperative blood loss or transfusion. Does not align with the review objective.

Not a randomized controlled trial; compares consecutive patients before and after introduction of PFA-100 screening, with desmopressin given only to those with abnormal PFA tests. No random assignment.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind trial in 60 children undergoing cardiac surgery, comparing DDAVP to placebo, with postoperative blood loss as outcome. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Randomized, placebo-controlled trial in 30 patients undergoing TKR, comparing DDAVP, tranexamic acid, and placebo. Reports transfusion requirements, thus relevant.
Double-blinded, placebo-controlled RCT in 27 adult cardiac surgery patients, comparing DDAVP to placebo, with blood loss and transfusion as outcomes.
Pharmacokinetic study in healthy volunteers (or unspecified population), not a randomized controlled trial in surgical patients. Does not evaluate perioperative blood loss or transfusion.
Randomized, controlled, double-blind trial in 59 hepatectomy patients, comparing DDAVP to placebo, with blood loss and transfusion as outcomes. Meets all criteria.
Duplicate of study 62. Not a randomized controlled trial; before-and-after design with desmopressin administered only to those with abnormal screening.

Double-blinded RCT in 163 adults undergoing cardiac surgery, with four arms: placebo, tranexamic acid, desmopressin, both. Compares DDAVP to placebo and active comparator. Reports blood loss and transfusion.
Prospective, double-blind, randomized trial in 70 patients undergoing complex cardiac surgery, comparing DDAVP to placebo, with blood loss as outcome.
Reported as a randomized trial in 48 adult cardiac surgery patients, comparing DDAVP to placebo, with blood loss and transfusion as outcomes. Title in Chinese translation; meets criteria.
Randomized, double-blinded study in 40 CABG patients, comparing DDAVP to placebo, with postoperative blood loss as a secondary outcome. Relevant.
RCT but both arms received desmopressin; one arm added tranexamic acid. Does not compare DDAVP to placebo or an active comparator without DDAVP; thus does not isolate DDAVP efficacy.
Systematic review of tranexamic acid, not desmopressin. Does not evaluate DDAVP.
Consensus recommendation paper, not a randomised controlled trial. Not focused on desmopressin perioperative use.
Not an RCT; narrative review summarizing clinical indications of desmopressin.
RCT: prospective, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial of desmopressin vs placebo in CABG patients on antiplatelet therapy. No inherited bleeding disorders.
Not clearly an RCT; compares desmopressin to a control group but no mention of randomization.
Methodological paper about Cochrane intervention reviews, unrelated to desmopressin or perioperative transfusion.
Systematic review about transjugular liver biopsy, unrelated to the review question.
Case series (four children) on hyponatremia and seizures after DDAVP; not an RCT.
RCT: prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial of desmopressin vs placebo in valvular heart operations.
Meta-analysis, not an original RCT.
RCT: double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of desmopressin in severe aortic valve stenosis patients undergoing AVR. No inherited bleeding disorders.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled study (randomization implied) of desmopressin in aorto-iliac graft surgery. Population without inherited bleeding disorders.
RCT: patients randomly allocated to desmopressin or placebo in a prospective, double-blind trial for spinal fusion in idiopathic scoliosis.
RCT: prospective, randomized, double-blind trial of desmopressin vs placebo in complex congenital heart operations.
Focus on treatment of von Willebrand's disease, an inherited bleeding disorder. Review explicitly excludes patients with inherited bleeding disorders.
Guideline document, not an RCT.
RCT: prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of desmopressin in CABG with thromboelastographic risk stratification.
Phase II dose-escalation trial without a control group; not an RCT.
RCT: patients randomized equally to desmopressin or control in elective CABG. No inherited bleeding disorders.
Meta-analysis of double-blind, placebo-controlled trials; not an original RCT.
RCT: double-blind, randomized, prospective trial of desmopressin vs placebo in patients on cardiopulmonary bypass.
RCT: prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial of desmopressin in CABG patients on aspirin.
Non-randomized sequential allocation study (first 100 controls, next 100 treatment) in cosmetic facioplasty; not an RCT.
RCT: randomized, double-blind, prospective study of desmopressin vs placebo in total hip replacement.
RCT: prospective, randomized clinical trial of desmopressin vs placebo in uncomplicated CABG.
RCT: randomized, controlled, double-blinded trial of desmopressin in children with cerebral palsy undergoing spinal fusion. No inherited bleeding disorders.
Meta-analysis of pharmacological strategies, not an original RCT.
